svg.title: RES-493 back squat: bar velocity and plate force
svg.desc: Latent bar vertical velocity (blue) and summed foot force over system weight (green, right scale shifted by -1), with latent repetition descent and ascent bands.
svg.text: RES-493 back squat: bar velocity and plate force
Synthetic only. Repetition events come from bar/COM mechanics, not from the controller.
